note: Copy to config/indexers.json and fill in. That file is gitignored: it carries live api keys and the label->indexer mapping the published census deliberately does not. `label` is what appears in every committed artifact; `kind` is published too, because a public paid indexer and a private tracker are not interchangeable and a reader needs to know the shape of the fleet even when the names are withheld.
pace_note: pace_s overrides --pace for one indexer. Set it wide for anything that rate limits: the census is not in a hurry and a 429 wall costs more than the wait does.
